// TEMPORARY deployment mirror for external provider sources — generated by
// the provider scaffold from the resolved "shared" runtime profile.
//
// Why this file exists: the pinned @apifuse/provider-sdk does not pass a
// `deployment` key through defineProvider(), and external polyrepo sources
// never run the monorepo AST lint that catches the misplacement, so the
// platform's materialization contract
// (scripts/provider-deploy/materialize-provider.mjs) requires deploy.ts at
// the repository root until the SDK deployment passthrough lands
// (unify-provider-manifest-dx task 1.1). Without it the repository is
// PROVIDER_REPO_NOT_BOOTSTRAPPED and its first deploy fails.
//
// Keep these values in sync with the `deployment` intent on the default
// export in index.ts. Delete this file only when the SDK passthrough ships
// and the platform drops the requirement.
